args.goal: Check prior challenge missions and saved results before retrieving anything. If no equivalent work exists, screen one public sponsor or challenge platform for an open, no-entry-fee data challenge with a documented cash reward. Use at most one discovery page and two first-party notice or rules pages. Verify deadline, eligibility for the intended entrant and disclosed autonomous AI work, rights to inputs and submissions, submission route, payout terms, and a measurable judging criterion. Require a standalone submission that can be prepared using available public inputs and the offline executor. On a fit, execute a small baseline against the published criterion, save commands, actual output and source hashes, and prepare an entry or submission-ready sample for the authorized operator. Distinguish baseline score, submission, award and verified settlement. If a decisive condition is missing, save the specific source gap and what would reopen the route. Reuse existing work where possible, read back evidence, and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission, account creation, spending or public deployment.
